Campaign complete after 6 rounds and 72 new experiments.

- Best variant remains `DEEEIRTTNPVATEQYGSYSTNLQQGNR` with fitness `9.536`.
- The strongest newly discovered variant was `QEEEIRTTNPVATEQYGEASTNLQRGNR` at `8.416`.
- Exploitation was appropriate throughout: surrogate CV Spearman stayed around `0.902–0.908`, and the campaign never triggered the stall detector.
- Residual reflexion identified lethal or unsafe combinations involving `R5S/T6Q/N21D`, later `D0Q/E2Q/S17D/T20D`; these were avoided or not reinforced without evidence.
- The most consistently enriched favorable substitutions were `S17E`, `T20E`, and several `R27` substitutions, but their benefits were strongly context-dependent.
